newsitem.title: USA: Lockheed, Loral get final FTC OK.
newsitem.headline: Lockheed, Loral get final FTC OK.

text.p: The Federal Trade Commission has given final approval to a consent order allowing Lockheed Martin to acquire Loral Corp, the companies said Tuesday.
The FTC accepted the consent order without any changes from the order provisionally accepted in April, the companies said.
Lockheed Martin completed its $7-billion tender offer for Loral shares on April 23, 1996, following the FTC's acceptance of the proposed consent order for public comment.
The consent order allowed Lockheed Martin to complete the acquisition without any significant divestiture or significant impacts on its business activities, the company said.

The consent order removes any organizational conflict of interest that was a concern of the Federal Aviation Administration, protects proprietary information provided to Lockheed by military-aircraft manufacturers, and requires the creation of standards to prevent the exchange of certain, non-public information between Lockheed and Loral Space & Communications Ltd.
The former Loral units have initially joined Lockheed as a sixth business sector, called Tactical Systems.
